category: file host (Vietnamese: storage, direct download, Fcode per-download codes)

free_tier.stated: No free byte allowance is published on the pages read. The vendor sells access two ways: VIP from VND 3,000/day ('Siêu tiết kiệm, chỉ từ 3.000Đ/ ngày (VIP 30 ngày/ 90.000Đ)') and Fcode, a per-download code: '20.000 VND Cho 10 lượt tải/12h/50GB dung lượng tải' when bought through MoMo/ShopeePay/FPT Pay/VNPAY.
free_tier.notes: A free account exists and is what get-link shops resell access to; the site itself promotes VIP and Fcode as the paid paths. No free-tier quota sentence was found.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated on the pages read

retention.stated: not stated on the pages read; VIP includes '300GB lưu trữ trong đó có 50GB lưu trữ đảm bảo (file không bị xóa)'
retention.notes: The 50 GB is guaranteed storage inside the VIP quota, not a retention period.

egress.terms: VIP: 'tải dữ liệu với tốc độ tối đa lên đến 300GB mỗi ngày' (up to 300 GB per day at full speed). Fcode buys a 50 GB / 12 h bucket or a 4 h single download.
egress.free_allowance: 300 GB/day on VIP; 50 GB per Fcode

interface_detail: Public API host api.fshare.vn (the vendor's own payment and package pages live there); web download; Fshare Tool for Windows/macOS; mobile apps.
tooling: api.fshare.vn plus community Python clients published on PyPI (get-fshare, getlink_fshare) and several GitHub tools; no official rclone backend observed; the vendor's own Fshare Tool is the supported desktop path.
chaining: A Fshare VIP account is the upstream that a Vietnamese get-link shop resells, so paying Fshare directly replaces the shop; the 300 GB/day egress is 8.8x the 34 GB/day a 1 TiB month needs, which makes Fshare throughput sufficient and the payment rail the only real obstacle.

limits.value: 50 GB per Fcode; 10 downloads per 12 h
no single-file cap published on the pages read

limits_note: Fcode validity is short by construction: 12 hours for the 50 GB wallet-code bucket, 4 hours for the single SMS purchase.
binding_note: What stops an outside client is payment, recorded in identity_cost.

identity_cost.detail: Every published rail is Vietnamese: 'Mua Fcode bằng MoMo/ShopeePay/FPT Pay/VNPAY' or SMS 'FCODE gửi 8700 (Áp dụng cho các mạng Viettel, Mobifone, Vinaphone)'; VIP is also sold by domestic bank transfer to a named account. No card, PayPal or crypto rail appears on the Fcode or VIP pages.

reliability_note: Fcode delivery depends on a live QR scan inside a Vietnamese wallet app or an SMS from a Vietnamese carrier; a code that is not copied within the 12 h window is lost, and get-link shops report the Fshare get-link path itself as unstable.
confidence_note: Five vendor pages were read today (Fcode, VIP package, VIP benefits blog, api package page, 4share is separate). Buying a Fcode from outside Vietnam would settle the payment claim at measured; that purchase is what the record says cannot be done.

evidence.proved: '20.000 VND Cho 10 lượt tải/12h/50GB dung lượng tải khi mua Fcode bằng MoMo/ShopeePay/FPT Pay/VNPAY', '15.000 VNĐ cho 1 lượt tải/4h khi mua Fcode bằng SMS', 'FCODE gửi 8700 (Áp dụng cho các mạng Viettel, Mobifone, Vinaphone)'
VIP traffic cap and price: 'tải dữ liệu với tốc độ tối đa lên đến 300GB mỗi ngày'; 'Chỉ từ 3.000 đồng/ngày ... 300GB dung lượng mỗi ngày'
'Siêu tiết kiệm, chỉ từ 3.000Đ/ ngày (VIP 30 ngày/ 90.000Đ)'; 'Dung lượng lưu trữ: 300GB (gồm 50GB đảm bảo và 250GB lưu trữ có thời hạn)'
SMS VIP package: 'VIP 4 ngày - 15.000đ không giới hạn lượt tải', syntax 'BX FSHARE NAP15 FS gửi 9029' for Vinaphone/Mobifone and 'BX 15000 FSHARE FS gửi 9029' for Viettel

the host warns against the get-link layer and names why the shops are unreliable: 'người dùng sẽ bị giới hạn dung lượng dữ liệu tải, số lượng lượt tải trong ngày ... tốc độ tải không ổn định, dữ liệu khi tải xuống bị đứt quãng'

price_per_tb_month: VND 90,000 per 30 days (VIP, 300 GB/day cap); VND 20,000 per 50 GB Fcode
notes: The Vietnamese host at the centre of the local get-link economy. Read directly rather than through a comparison site. The storage plan (1 TB-100 TB, VND 450,000 per 3 months for 1 TB per FPT's page) is a separate product and is not what the get-link shops resell. Abandonment condition: Fshare publishes a card or international rail for Fcode.

extras.fpt_reseller_page: https://fpt.vn/vi/khach-hang-ca-nhan/san-pham-dich-vu/dich-vu-online/fshare.html lists Storage 1TB at VND 450,000/3 months and VND 1,500,000/year
